items.title: Dole State and Tribal Outreach Grant Program

data.abstract: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is proposing regulations to implement the Dole State and Tribal Outreach Grant Program (DSTOGP), as authorized under the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act. This program aids veterans and their families by awarding funding to eligible organizations to carry out programs to improve covered outreach and assistance to ensure that veterans and their families are fully informed about, and assisted in applying for, any veterans and veterans-related benefits and programs (including veterans programs of a State or Indian Tribe) for which they may be eligible.

items.title: Safety Zone; Huron River, Huron, OH

data.abstract: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters of the Huron River within a 150-yard radius of 41[deg]23'34.6" N, 82[deg]33'07.7" W in Huron, OH. The safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards created by an over water fireworks show. Entry of vessels or persons into this zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Detroit, or their designated representative.

items.title: Special Local Regulation: Marine Events Within the Captain of the Port Miami, Seminole Hard Rock Winterfest Holiday Boat Parade

data.abstract: The Coast Guard will enforce a special local regulation to provide for the safety of life on navigable waterways during the Seminole Hard Rock Winterfest Holiday Boat Parade. Our regulation for marine events within the Captain of the Port Miami identifies the regulated area for this event in Fort Lauderdale, FL. All non- participant persons and vessels are prohibited from entering, transiting, anchoring, or remaining within the regulated area during the enforcement period unless authorized by the Captain of the Port Miami or a designated representative. The operator of any vessel in the regulated area must comply with directions from the Coast Guard or designated representative.

items.title: Safety Zone; FRL Inaugural Invitational eFoil Exhibition Race, Miami Marine Stadium Basin, Miami, FL

data.abstract: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for certain navigable waters of the Miami Marine Stadium Basin in connection with the FRL Inaugural Invitational eFoil Exhibition Race. This safety zone is necessary to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with the eFoil races. This rule prohibits entry of vessels or persons into this safety zone unless authorized by the Captain of the Port Sector Miami or its designated representative.

items.title: Airworthiness Directives; Airbus Helicopters Deutschland GmbH (AHD) Helicopters

data.abstract: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for all Airbus Helicopters Deutschland GmbH (AHD) Model MBB-BK 117 C-1 and MBB-BK 117 C-2 helicopters with a certain air conditioning system installed in accordance with FAA Supplemental Type Certificate (STC) No. SR00601DE. This proposed AD was prompted by reports of corrosion on the condenser inlet duct, which caused the internal support wire helix to impinge the tail rotor (TR) drive shaft. This proposed AD would require repetitively inspecting the TR drive shaft; repetitively inspecting the exterior of the Air Comm Corporation (ACC) condenser duct assembly (duct assembly); repetitively inspecting (using a borescope) the interior of the ACC duct assembly; and depending on the results of these inspections, replacing certain parts. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

Target Product Profile for a Rapid Diagnostic Test for West Nile Virus Disease: Request for Information
tags: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

agencies: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
data.abstract: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) in the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) announces the opening of a docket to obtain comment on the proposed Target Product Profile for a Rapid Diagnostic Test for West Nile Virus Disease for Use in Hospitals and Clinical Laboratories. This Request for Information (RFI) invites comments and suggestions on the proposed target product profile. HHS/ CDC is publishing this target product profile to improve the likelihood of developing a commercially available diagnostic assay that can be used to rapidly diagnose West Nile virus infection. Public input is a valuable component in developing a useful target product profile.

items.title: Accuracy of Advertising and Notice of Insured Status

data.abstract: The NCUA Board (Board) is issuing this final rule to streamline its regulations governing advertising and the notice of insured status. This final rule eliminates provisions concerning the official advertising statement. This action is undertaken to reduce regulatory complexity, and the intended effect is to reduce the administrative burden and costs for federally insured credit unions (FICUs) and provide them with greater flexibility in their advertising activities. The final rule does not amend requirements related to displaying the official sign.

items.title: Burlington Electric Department; Notice of Application Tendered for Filing With the Commission and Establishing Procedural Schedule for Licensing and Deadline for Submission of Final Amendments
Combined Notice of Filings
Combined Notice of Filings #2
Combined Notice of Filings #1
Nondiscrimination Requirements

data.abstract: The NCUA Board (Board) is publishing this final rule to remove a redundant and outdated regulation regarding nondiscrimination in lending. The regulation was intended to summarize the Fair Housing Act (FHA) prohibitions on discrimination related to real estate related loans, appraisals, and advertising. The Board's last substantive amendment to the regulation was finalized in 2001. Thus, the regulation does not reflect all case law or regulatory developments under the FHA, a statute that primarily falls under the jurisdiction of the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) and continues to apply to federal credit unions (FCUs) regardless of this regulation. For these reasons, the Board is removing the regulation in its entirety.

items.title: Restoring Flexibility To Support Head Start Program Access

data.abstract: In this final rule, the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) removes requirements from the Head Start Program Performance Standards (Performance Standards) to restore local flexibility to Head Start programs and improve access to quality services. Specifically, this final rule removes requirements related to wages and benefits that the Administration believes are not in line with the plain language of the Head Start Act and are costly and overly prescriptive for Head Start programs and staff. ACF estimates these changes will result in over $2 billion in future cost savings for Head Start programs. The rescissions in this final rule impact the costliest parts of the final rule published by the Office of Head Start (OHS) in 2024, Supporting the Head Start Workforce and Consistent Quality Programming.
